questions.question: The volume of a right circular cone is 1232 cm³ and its height is 24 cm. What is its curved surface area? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
** Given: **

Height = 24cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a right circular cone = (1)/(3)pi {r²}h

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1/3) × (22/7) × r²× 24 = 1232, r² = 49

⇒ r = 7 cm

Lateral height = √(r² + h²)

= √(7² + 24²) = √625 = 25

Surface area = π r l = 22/7 × 7 × 25

**∴ The curved surface area is 550 cm².**

questions.question: A, B and C, working alone can do a piece of work in 12, 24 and 36 days respectively. They work together and get Rs. 3850 for completing the work. What is the difference in shares of B and C?
questions.solution:
Time propto (1)/({Efficiency)}, Efficiency ∝share (salary)

The ratio of time, A : B : C = 12 : 24 : 36

⇒ A : B : C = 1 : 2 : 3

The ratio of shares,

Rightarrow A:B:C = (1)/(1):(1)/(2):(1)/(3)

⇒ A : B : C = 6 : 3 : 2

⇒ Let the share of A, B and C be 6x, 3x and 2x

⇒ Total money = 3850

⇒ 6x + 3x + 2x = 3850

⇒ 11x = 3850

⇒ x = 350

⇒ The difference in shares of B and C = 3x – 2x = x = Rs. 350

∴ The difference in shares of B and C is Rs. 350.

The simple interest on a certain sum for two years at the rate of 20% per annum is Rs. 250. What is the compound interest (compounded annually) on the same sum for the same period at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Formula, Simple interest = PRT/100

⇒ 250 = (P × 20 × 2)/100

⇒ P = Rs. 625

⇒ C.I. = P[(1 + r/100)t – 1]

⇒ C.I. = 625[(6/5)² – 1]

⇒ C.I. = 25 × 11 = Rs. 275

∴ The compound interest is Rs. 275.

questions.question: The average speed of a car is 600 metres/minute. How much slower (in metres/second) does the car run than a sprinter who covers 100 metres in 9.6 seconds?
questions.solution:
The average speed of a car = 600 metres/minute = 10 m/s

⇒ Speed = distance/time

⇒ The average speed of a sprinter = 100/9.6 m/s

⇒ Difference of the average speed of car and sprinter = (100/9.6) – 10

⇒ Difference of the average speed of car and sprinter = 40/96 = 5/12 m/s

∴ The car runs (5/12) m/s slower than a sprinter.

questions.question: Average age of mother and father is 28 years. Average age of mother, father and their child is 20 years. What is the age of child?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age of mother and father = 28 years

Average age of mother, father and their child = 20 years

**Formula used:**

⇒ Average age = (total~age ~of~ all~ persons)/(number~ of~ persons)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of mother and father = 28 × 2 = 56 years ...(1)

⇒ Total age of mother, father and their child = 20 × 3 = 60 years ...(2)

From (1) and (2),

⇒ The age of child = 60 – 56 = 4 years

**∴ The age of child is 4 years.**

questions.question: A mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 4 ∶ 3 (by volume). If 4 litres of water is added to it, then the ratio becomes 1 ∶ 1. What is the quantity of milk in the initial mixture?
questions.solution:
Let the quantity of milk and water be 4x and 3x in the initial mixture.

Rightarrow frac{{4x}}{{3x + 4}} = (1)/(1)

⇒ 4x = 3x + 4

⇒ x = 4

⇒ The quantity of milk in the initial mixture = 4x = 16 litres

∴ The quantity of milk in the initial mixture is 16 litres.

questions.question: A bag contains coins of 1 rupees, 50 paise and 25 paise in the ratio of 1 : 2 : 4. If the total money in the bag is Rs. 225, then how many 50 paise coins are there?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A bag contains coins of 1 rupees, 50 paise and 25 paise in the ratio of 1 : 2 : 4.

**Calculation:**

Let the number of coins of 1 rupees, 50 paise and 25 paise be x, 2x and 4x.

Total money = 225

⇒ x + 2x/2 + 4x/4 = 225

⇒3x = 225

⇒x = 75

⇒Number of coins of 50 paise = 2x = 150

**∴ Number of coins of 50 paise is 150.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 2000 is invested at compound interest (compounding annually). If the rate of interest is 10% per annum, then what will be the amount after 30 months?
questions.solution:
Interest for first year = 2000 × 10% = 200

⇒ Interest for second year = (2000 + 200) × 10% = 220

⇒ Interest for third year = (2000 + 200 + 220) × 10% = 242

⇒ But interest for 6 months in third year = Interest for third year/2 = 242/2 = 121

⇒ Total interest in 30 months = Interest for first year + Interest for second year + interest for 6 months in third year

⇒ Total interest in 30 months = 200 + 220 + 121 = Rs. 541

⇒ The amount after 30 months = 2000 + 541 = Rs. 2541

∴ The amount will be Rs. 2541 after 30 months.

questions.question: A train takes 1 minute to cross a stationary pole. How much time (in seconds) will it take to cross a bridge whose length is twice that of the train?
questions.solution:
Let the length of train be x

Speed of train = length of train/time

Speed of train = x/60

Length of the bridge = 2x

Speed of train = (length of train + length of bridge) /time

x/60 = (x + 2x) /time

time = 60 × 3 = 180 seconds

∴ Train will take 180 seconds to cross the bridge.

questions.question: The average of 4 numbers is 9. If another number 14 is included, then what is the new average?
questions.solution:
The average of 4 numbers = 9

⇒ Average = Sum of all numbers/Number of term

⇒ 9 = Sum of 4 numbers/4

⇒ Sum of 4 numbers = 36

⇒ Sum of 5 numbers = 36 + 14 = 50

⇒ New average = 50/5 = 10

∴ The new average is 10.

questions.question: 10 men working 8 hours day can do a work in 30 days. In how many days will 12 men working 4 hours a day take to the same work?
questions.solution:
Man₁ × Hour₁ × Day₁ = Man₂ × Hour₂ × Day₂

⇒ 10 × 8 × 30 = 12 × 4 × Day₂

⇒ Day₂ = 50 days

∴ 12 men working 4 hours a day will complete the same work in 50 days.

questions.question: An article is sold at two successive discounts of 10% and 20%. If the selling price is Rs. 1080, then what is the marked price?

Rightarrow x times frac{{100 - 10}}{{100}} times frac{{100 - 20}}{{100}} = 1080

Rightarrow x times (9)/({10)} times (8)/({10)} = 1080

⇒ x = Rs. 1500

∴ The marked price is Rs. 1500.

questions.question: What is the largest four-digit number, which is divisible by 32, 40, 36 and 48?
questions.solution:
Factors of 32, 40, 36 and 48

⇒ 32 = 2⁵

⇒ 40 = 2³ × 5

⇒ 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ 48 = 2⁴ × 3

⇒ L.C.M. of 32, 40 and 48 = 2⁵ × 3² × 5 = 1440

⇒ The largest four-digit number is = 9999

When we divide 9999 by 1440, we get the remainder of 1359.

Largest 4 digit number which is divisible by 32, 40, 36 and 48 = 9999 - 1359 = 8640

∴ The largest four-digit number is 8640.

questions.question: An article is sold at 22.5% profit. What is the ratio of the cost price to the selling price?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be 100x

⇒ Selling price = cost price × (100 + profit)%

⇒ Selling price = 100x × 122.5%

⇒ Selling price = 122.5x

⇒ The ratio of the cost price to the selling price = 100x : 122.5x = 40 : 49

∴ The ratio of the cost price to the selling price is 40 : 49.
